benchmark.name: ITER_1D
benchmark.license: CC BY 4.0, per upstream repository LICENSE

input_identity.source_library_policy: The bundled libsource.so is not trusted or loaded. The source C++ law is text-checked and represented by the documented OpenMC IndependentSource API; its hash is retained in every run receipt.

source_model.finite_rejection_limit_difference: The C++ source returns a zero-weight site after 100000 failed box proposals; the IndependentSource domain constraint resamples until acceptance. Based on exact cell/box volumes, per-proposal acceptance is 0.6229173834875004 and log10 probability of 100000 consecutive rejects is -42356.348808420196. This makes the finite cap operationally negligible for this geometry, not mathematically identical.
source_model.equivalence_scope: Same declared source probability law apart from finite-cap branch; different RNG stream; this is not bytewise source-bank equivalence.

geometry_control.cell_volume_method: Exact analytic annular volume from each cell's simple signed z-cylinder/z-plane halfspaces; all cells must form a contiguous nonoverlapping radial partition from r=0 to outer vacuum boundary and share the reflective z extent.

response_plan.raw_unit: particle-cm per source neutron per cell
response_plan.derived_response: divide by exact cell volume [cm^3] for volume-average particle/cm^2 per source neutron

response_plan.raw_unit: reactions per source neutron per cell
response_plan.derived_response: divide by exact cell volume [cm^3] for reactions/cm^3 per source neutron

sampling_plan.criterion: Input/statepoint/estimator/shape and finite nonnegative finite tally mean/error validation only; no sampling-sigma pass band is used for physics qualification.
sampling_plan.covariance: Tallies use the same histories and are correlated. Different estimators avoid a direct estimator-algebra identity, but this control does not claim independent samples; per-bin standard errors are retained and never summed as if independent.

temperature_treatment.basis: The worker makes the OpenMC room-temperature default explicit; this does not bound reactor operating temperatures.

data_identity.candidate: FENDL-3.2 OpenMC HDF5 distribution from existing local cache
data_identity.per_material_neutron_files: Every run receipt identifies each neutron data file selected for nuclides appearing in the benchmark materials by path and SHA-256.
limits: The local data audit found one 294 K evaluation temperature; this is not a temperature-bounding demonstration.
Acquisition/redistribution terms and publisher archive checksum are unresolved; data are not copied into this repository.
Data presence does not qualify any response or validate experimental agreement.

solver_identity.version_check: OpenMC Python API, executable --version, and statepoint version must agree; executable/Python/data identities are recorded per run.

comparison.reason: No provenance-qualified reference response set is configured. A local JADE dummy ITER_1D statepoint has metadata (OpenMC 0.15.3, 100 realizations, seed 1, FENDL 3.2b) but lacks the exact run settings and hashed source/geometry/material/tally inputs. It is retained as a lead only, not a numeric acceptance target.

unqualified_local_candidate.use: Provenance investigation only. Do not use as the comparison target unless the producing input and run receipts are recovered and verified.

pilot_evidence.caveat: This is a 10000-history integration pilot, not a precision or benchmark acceptance result; code-to-code qualification remains NOT_EVALUATED.
